say:3:1423329001:1.text: You're here! I did a bit of reading ahead of time, brought some cooking gear... and a bunch of other things we might need.
say:3:1423329001:1.source_cn: 你们来啦！我提前做了一些功课，查阅了书籍，带了炊具……...

say:4:1423329002:1.text: I checked the map. There's a lift at Moon Lift Shaft that leads straight to the commoners' district. I thought we could head out that way today.
say:4:1423329002:1.source_cn: 我看了地图，月落升降井处的升降机可以通往泽被平民区，所...

say:5:1423329003:1.text: Sounds like Orlana's ready to be the guide this time.
say:5:1423329003:1.source_cn: 感觉欧罗娜都可以为我们带路了呢。

say:6:1423329004:1.text: We know that route too! Let's get moving!
say:6:1423329004:1.source_cn: 那条路线我们也很熟悉！我们出发吧！
